Markup-fidelity fixture for the FOOTER shell — the `.pc-layout__footer` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Layout.footer/1`, svelte `layout/Footer.svelte`). A SHELL component migrated DOWN into @keenmate/pure-css, so the root block class is `pc-layout__footer` (NOT `pa-footer`); confirmed in dist/css/main.css. The three SECTIONS are a SIBLING block `pc-footer` (note the `-footer` not `__`/`--` after pc-layout) with element classes `pc-footer__start` / `__center` / `__end` and the modifier `pc-footer__end--vertical`. Both blocks are listed under `blocks` so axis-1 checks the section classes too. SCOPE = CONTAINER + its three sections — unlike navbar/sidebar this root reconciles: the footer root carries NO hook and NO id on EITHER wrapper (footer has no JS driver), so a shared golden IS possible. The one reconcilable shape is ALL THREE SECTIONS SUPPLIED with explicit content: then both wrappers emit exactly `
…
…
…
`. The scenarios deliberately supply all three slots to sidestep the two documented divergences: (1) EMPTY SECTIONS — svelte in three-section mode ALWAYS emits all three section divs (filling each conditionally), while keen OMITS a section div whose slot is empty AND has no config fallback; supplying all three makes both emit all three. (2) CONFIG FALLBACKS — with every slot supplied, neither wrapper's config copyright/version fallback fires (keen wraps the fallback in , svelte in a /

— divergent, so avoided). The svelte-only `endVertical` → `pc-footer__end--vertical` has no keen counterpart, so it is NOT a shared feature — deferred as prose. Section CONTENTS are plain slot tokens (the diff checks the container + three section divs + nesting, not rich content). Canonical shape: packages/core/snippets/layout.html (footer).

propsVocabulary.start: inline-start section content (copyright area) — pc-footer__start. svelte `start`, keen `start`.
propsVocabulary.center: flexible middle section content — pc-footer__center. svelte `center`, keen `center`.
propsVocabulary.end: inline-end section content (version/links) — pc-footer__end. svelte `end`, keen `end_` (keen's slot is named end_ to avoid the Elixir `end` keyword).
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the root <footer class="pc-layout__footer ..."> (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough; not a core modifier.

goldenConventions:
Goldens encode the all-three-sections shape both wrappers agree on. Every scenario supplies start + center + end so (a) svelte's always-three-divs three-section mode and keen's omit-empty-sections mode converge on the same three divs, and (b) neither wrapper's config copyright/version fallback fires (their fallback wrappers — keen vs svelte

— would diverge). Section contents are plain tokens. The svelte-only endVertical / pc-footer__end--vertical modifier is not exercised (no keen counterpart). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pc-layout__footer' + '\.pc-footer'). The pc-layout__footer BLOCK has ZERO modifiers and ZERO element classes of its own (the sections live on the sibling pc-footer block). pc-footer block: element classes __start/__center/__end + the modifier pc-footer__end--vertical. Each section is a slot that produces its section div class. The --vertical modifier is svelte-only (no keen attr), so it is NOT a shared oracle feature — it is accounted for via cssStateClasses-style deferral below so axis-1's reverse block-modifier check (pc-footer--*) stays clean (note: pc-footer__end--vertical is an ELEMENT modifier, matched by ^pc-footer__, so it is covered by `deferred`). `produces: null` for extraClass (passthrough).

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the root pc-layout__footer footer; svelte `class`, keen `class`.

deferred.//: The one element-modifier class under ^pc-footer__ that no shared feature produces: pc-footer__end--vertical. It is svelte-only (the `endVertical` prop toggles it; keen's footer/1 has no such attr), so it can't be a shared oracle feature. Acknowledged as PROSE — out of the shared strict-compare surface — so the axis-1 element-class reverse check accounts for it.
deferred.pc-footer__end--vertical: stacks the end-section items vertically (flex-column). svelte `endVertical` prop → class; keen has NO counterpart attr, so it is wrapper-asymmetric and not a shared feature. Exercised by neither scenario.

scenarios.name: three-sections
scenarios.note: All three sections supplied → both wrappers emit all three section divs (keen omits empty sections, svelte always emits three; supplying all three converges them). No config fallback fires.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pc-layout__footer on the root; token order is normalized away.
